incidents.name: Intermittent Issues with User Registration and Login

incident_updates.body: The issue affecting user registrations and logins has been resolved. Normal system operations have resumed.

We have successfully implemented a fix and closely monitored the results. We can confirm that user registration and login processes are fully recovered and functioning normally. Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.

We are currently identifying an issue affecting a small percentage of users attempting to log in or register. Some users may encounter an error when trying to sign up or sign in to Miro.

Workaround: If you encounter an error during registration, please refresh the page and try again. A subsequent attempt should be successful.

Our engineering team is actively looking into the root cause, and we will provide another update shortly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

incidents.name: Trying to contact support redirects some users to a login page that rejects all login attempts.

incident_updates.body:
The login loop issue that some users experienced after attempting to contact support has been fully resolved. 
If you’re still experiencing issues, please use an alternative link to get in touch with us:   [https://miro.com/contact/recover/
](https://miro.com/contact/recover/)
We apologize for the inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

We’re investigating an issue where trying to contact support (e.g. via a link in Learning Center) redirects some users to a login page that rejects all login attempts. In some cases, this may affect subsequent normal SSO login attempts, until browser cookies are cleared.

Workaround:

• If impacted, clear browser cache/cookies to restore login.

• Support tickets can be submitted via <https://miro.com/contact/recover/>

Our engineering team is working to identify the root cause and will provide updates as we learn more. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience.
